charts.title: How the steeling test was built: one model, a placebo window and two nulls.
charts.takeaway: The moderate-drought coefficient had to clear both nulls; it reached +0.039 against a time-shift bar of 0.065.

steps.label: 1,175 sites, 3,780 events
steps.detail: Tree-ring sites in the contiguous United States, 65 species, 177 climate divisions. An event is a severe drought year with rings three years either side.

steps.label: Group each event by earlier drought
steps.detail: Lowest summer drought index four to eleven years before: none (986), moderate (941), severe (1,853).

steps.label: Fit log resilience
steps.detail: Resilience is growth after the drought over growth before it. The model has site and year effects; the tested term is the moderate group.

steps.label: Placebo window
steps.detail: Group by drought five to twelve years after the event. It gave +0.006 (p 0.86).

steps.label: Time-shift null
steps.detail: Move each division's drought record by 20 or more years and rebuild every event, 200 times. 95th percentile 0.065.

steps.label: Label-permutation null
steps.detail: Shuffle the prior-drought labels among each site's own events, 500 times. 95th percentile 0.020.

steps.label: Rule: above 0, adjusted q below 0.05, above both nulls
steps.detail: Written and hash-locked before the run.

charts.title: Effect of an earlier drought on resilience and on its two parts, with 95% intervals.
charts.takeaway: Every resilience interval reaches 0 (moderate +0.039); after a severe prior drought resistance fell by 0.087 and recovery rose by 0.096, which cancel.
charts.units: change in the natural log of a Lloret index (growth ratio around a severe drought) against events with no prior drought; above 0 means a higher index
charts.n: 3,780 site-drought events at 1,175 sites, 65 species; placebo window 3,976 events; rerun 2,549 events at 1,097 sites
charts.interval: 95% interval, standard errors clustered by climate division
charts.baseline: Events with no drought in the window four to eleven years earlier (the line at 0)
charts.threshold: Moderate-drought coefficient above 0 with adjusted q below 0.05 and above both nulls' 95th percentile; placebo p at or above 0.05
charts.ruled_out: A steeling effect larger than +0.090 on log resilience (upper end of the 95% interval, main run); +0.059 in the rerun

charts.title: The moderate-drought estimate against each null's range, main run and rerun.
charts.takeaway: The estimate sits inside the time-shift range in both runs (+0.039 against 0.065, then +0.025 against 0.038) and clears only the weaker label shuffle.
charts.units: moderate prior drought coefficient on log resilience; higher means more resilience after an earlier moderate drought
charts.n: 3,780 site-drought events at 1,175 sites, 65 species; rerun 2,549 events at 1,097 sites; 200, 500 and 200 null draws
charts.interval: 5th to 95th percentile of the null draws
charts.baseline: Time-shift null: each drought record moved by 20 or more years, which keeps its pattern and breaks its link with the rings. Label-permutation null: labels shuffled within a site.
charts.threshold: Real estimate above the null's 95th percentile, fixed before each run; the time-shift null is the one the rule binds
charts.ruled_out: A moderate-drought effect beyond what a time-shifted drought record gives: +0.039 is below 0.065 (p 0.18), and in the rerun +0.025 is below 0.038 (p 0.14)

charts.title: Every rule set in advance for the tree-ring test, the value it tested and the bar.
charts.takeaway: 4 of 10 rules held. The placebo was clean (p 0.86); the adjusted q of 0.166 and the time-shift bar failed, so steeling is not shown.
